sources.card_type_definitions: n8n-designs/design/choices/v4/capabilities/*.yaml (R193, R228: every file; archetype outputs inherited per (list, slot) from the reference type): inputs = the explicit `inputs:` section only (R194; [] when absent); outputs = every releasing key (minus handoff_comment_id); acceptance = every inspecting check as '<LIST>: <check>'
sources.custom_field_groups: RM master (George 10-13 v4 ruling 12): seeded from fr backend/src/services/improvement-cards/field-groups.ts GROUP_FIELDS @ feat/fr-rm-pm-catalogue de6c7763 (retired stopwatch_timeout excluded); + project_type, phase, capability (D4); + released (ruling 10; R66: no rework_count); + source_artifact_id, source_item_id (R188); + wait_for_phase (bool, R190); + spec_hash in Metadata (R311: the card birth key, kanban-coach-errors.md §7 item 1); + criterion_ids in Relations (R-CK10: the acceptance-criterion ids a card serves, a JSON or comma list like required_by, read by name by ct.project_closure.doing)

v4_rulings.scope: George 10-13 R184: one IT project type `it` (replaces bug_hunt_fix, feature_new, feature_update, integration_report); program, meta_prompt, meta_procedure, kaizen unchanged; George 2026-10-31 Kata K15: the `kata` type, with the first-build phases of `it` (setup, preliminary, execution), the setup card types of `it` and (Kata WP4, George 2026-11-01) the four kata-only preliminary workflow_engineering card types, plus (Kata WP5, George 2026-11-03) the execution-phase wf_change
v4_rulings.phases: R185; George 2026-11-03: it = setup -> preliminary -> analysis -> design -> execution -> test (closure is fr's, not RM's)
v4_rulings.matrix: R185 phases; R228 (George 10-14): it places every v4-defined card type; George 2026-11-03 by capability: analysis -> analysis; architecture, design, bdd_tdd -> design; testing -> test; choice_option_development (R331) and decision_development (its upstream) -> execution; every other type in its design `phase` (development_bug_fix execution); PM types fixed (project_closure in test); entry card type project_start_request_analysis (R88); EXCEPT the KATA-ONLY workflow_engineering types (Kata WP4, George 2026-11-01: wf_observe, wf_probe, wf_root_cause, wf_andon_scope; Kata WP5, George 2026-11-03: wf_change), which are placed on `kata` alone
v4_rulings.additions: George 10-13 v4 ruling 9: capability kanban_coach; card types project_phase_start, project_phase_closure (project_management), text from n8n-designs design/choices/v4 (kanban_coach: model.md, first designed in capabilities/kanban_coach.yaml @ afcf981; project_management.yaml); phase_coverage_check: retired by R347 (4)

sources.card_type_rules: n8n_custom_nodes AA_IMPLEMENTATION/coding_card_types.json @ bd97bbede (repo_write, container_read_exec, setup); no_reclassify_target and dependency_upgrade per the fr computed-gating brief

project_phases.name: setup
project_phases.title: Setup
project_phases.description: The system phase every project starts in, before its first work phase (George 10-13 v4 ruling 2).

project_phases.name: preliminary
project_phases.title: Preliminary
project_phases.description: Research and change management before the analysis: frame what the later phases act on (R185; George 2026-11-03).
project_phases.output: published research and change-management documents (research, change_management)
project_phases.exit_rule: project_phase_closure released after an approved phase sign-off; it starts the next phase (R88, R92)

project_phases.name: analysis
project_phases.title: Analysis
project_phases.description: Find what the work acts on (George 2026-11-03).
project_phases.output: a published findings report, every finding with its status (bug_analysis, R163)
project_phases.exit_rule: project_phase_closure released after an approved phase sign-off; approval approves every confirmed finding (R88, R92, R186)

project_phases.name: design
project_phases.title: Design
project_phases.description: Shape the work before it is built: architecture, design and the tests that come first (George 2026-11-03).
project_phases.output: published architecture and design documents and RM assets, and the tests written first (architecture, design, bdd_tdd)
project_phases.exit_rule: project_phase_closure released after an approved phase sign-off; it starts the next phase (R88, R92)

project_phases.name: execution
project_phases.title: Execution
project_phases.description: The work: act on what the earlier phases found (R185).
project_phases.output: one merged pull request per confirmed finding (development_bug_fix, R167)
project_phases.exit_rule: project_phase_closure released after an approved phase sign-off; it starts the next phase (R88, R92)

project_phases.name: test
project_phases.title: Test
project_phases.description: Test what the execution phase built (George 2026-11-03).
project_phases.output: published testing documents and test reports, and merged tests (testing)
project_phases.exit_rule: project_phase_closure released after an approved phase sign-off; it creates project_closure (R88, R92)
